description: Momentum & pressure index for a live T20 chase — quantifies which side is gaining (the swing signal) plus a pressure score. In-play trader signal. Pay per call via x402.

curr.description: The later state, same shape. A pair in the wrong order is refused before payment.

prev.description: The earlier state {balls_bowled, wickets, cum_runs}; balls_bowled is legal balls (12.3 overs = 75). A `target` inside it may be left out; if sent, it must equal the call's.

venue.description: The ground's name, applied to both states.

name: hsh-cricket-momentum
